US Winery Sold Due to Canadian Tariffs and Boycott

A family-owned California winery, McManis Family Vineyards, is being sold, including 10 vineyards, due to tariffs imposed by Canada and a subsequent boycott. Ron McManis stated it was a very hard decision for himself and his family. The tariffs were reportedly imposed by former US President Trump.
